node.title: Predictable Delivery — initiative tracking & forecasting
node.summary: Creates transparency, predictability, and consistency across cross-team initiatives via tracking, delay/overrun forecasting, and capacity analytics.
node.interview_question: This is a PMO/planning surface outside the Observe/Optimize/Govern thesis — does it dilute the story or extend it?
